logic_errors.finding: An unclassified worker exception consumes the completion and clears IsStorageBusy, but leaves CurrentView.storageBusy=true and its old stage. The exact pending request remains, yet Retry is denied by PresentationRules. The session is permanently presented as Saving instead of an actionable storage error.
logic_errors.reproduction: Actual SessionStore after-prepare injector throws ApplicationException on the worker. Update surfaces ApplicationException; observed busy=False, dtoBusy=True, stage=ready, pending=True, retry=False.
logic_errors.scope: Adversarial injected unexpected exception, not a claim that ordinary IOException handling failed. RunStorage filtering predates this change, but stale busy DTO is a new async failure mode.
logic_errors.requested_correction: Handle every worker completion failure on the main thread with a truthful nonbusy error projection while preserving exact pending and original exception; do not reroll or acknowledge it.

logic_errors.finding: A ViewPublished subscriber can synchronously Shutdown during completion publication. SetView resumes after all shutdown callbacks and unconditionally assigns presentation.View, restoring a view after cleanup.
logic_errors.reproduction: On sealed nonbusy completion, actual ViewPublished subscriber calls game.Shutdown(); ShutdownCompleted clears the presentation View. After Drain returns, presentation.View is nonnull again. No late cue was emitted, but a post-cleanup presentation assignment occurred.
logic_errors.scope: SetView has an inherited reentrancy hazard; this review does not label that line newly introduced. The new asynchronous completion path still fails the requested no-late-publication teardown contract.
logic_errors.requested_correction: After synchronous authority callbacks return, do not touch presentation if shutdown closed the owner; preserve nested stricter-gate behavior and legacy regression contracts.

logic_errors.finding: RequestQuit closes DispatchCommand but not public TrySelectSet. During a deferred busy Quit, completion publication exposes an idle results state before Update reaches Shutdown, so a reentrant subscriber can change the selected printing and publish again after quit intent.
logic_errors.reproduction: Actual three approved Phase5 configs, real Generate/Open, hold Skip at after-prepare, RequestQuit, release; nonbusy results ViewPublished subscriber calls TrySelectSet(jungle-en-unlimited1999). It returns true and SelectedPrintingId changes to jungle before cleanup.
logic_errors.scope: New deferred-quit window. Busy gating itself correctly denies selection until completion. No RNG or durable action was regenerated in the reproduction.
logic_errors.requested_correction: Include quitRequested in direct public selection authority (and audit other direct mutation/export seams), not only DispatchCommand; coalesced exit intent must remain dominant.
